harness: simulation/harness/run_tank_coil_sweep.py (per-pan f_sw fixed-point comparison) + a one-off ngspice probe via run_zvs_sweep.py's override_params/run_ngspice_on_text for tank-capacitor voltage
purpose: Compare ZVS margin, tank current, and delivered power at the OLD declared f_switching (main.ato:71, 35kHz pre-2026-07-27-fix) vs. the NEW declared value (47kHz) across all four pan presets, holding the coil inductance fixed at L=150uH (the evidence candidate from docs/evidence/2026-07-27-pan-preset-correction.md -- an ASSUMPTION, not a specified/measured coil; inductor_conn remains a placeholder in modules.ato) so the comparison isolates the frequency change alone.
c_tank_source: modules.ato c_tank1 (150nF) + c_tank2 (150nF) in parallel; COMMITTED, fixed
l_assumption_source: docs/evidence/2026-07-27-pan-preset-correction.md Sec 4.5 -- NOT a specified coil; inductor_conn (modules.ato ResonantTank) remains an unplaced placeholder
falsifier: If raising f_switching to ~47kHz (paired with the L=150uH evidence-candidate) fails to hold ZVS (margin < 10%, this harness's own zvs_held threshold) for ALL FOUR pan presets, or if cast_iron/stainless's tank current at the new point exceeds OCP-01's 50.1A peak trip (main.ato i_ocp_trip_peak), then raising frequency alone does not fix the operating point and the fix is incomplete.
falsifier_result: Did not fire. All four presets show margin_pct < 1% (zvs_held) at the new 47kHz point (see old_vs_new_by_pan). cast_iron/stainless tank peak current at the new point is 28.755A, 43% below OCP-01's 50.1A trip. aluminum/no_pan were already zvs_held at the old 35kHz point (under the L=150uH assumption) and remain held at the new point, with power delivery falling further (2.7W and 0.02W respectively) -- expected, not a failure: their loaded resonance (~24kHz) is far below 47kHz, so a controller relying on a single fixed nominal frequency would need the PLL/ZVS tracking loop (main.ato:72, asserted 20-100kHz, unchanged) to pull the operating frequency down toward ~24-25kHz for these pans to deliver real power -- see the knock-on analysis in the accompanying markdown.

tank_capacitor_voltage_check.purpose: modules.ato asserts c_tank1/c_tank2.voltage_rating (1600V each) >= v_tank_peak (400V, a DECLARED design assumption, not derived from simulation) * 1.43 = 572V. This checks what the simulated tank-capacitor voltage (V(sw)-V(tank_mid), NOT the switch-node voltage V(sw) alone) actually is at each point, against both the 400V design assumption and the 1600V physical rating.
tank_capacitor_voltage_check.verdict: The 1600V component rating is not violated in any tested scenario (worst observed 694.71V, >2x margin remaining). The DECLARED 400V design assumption (v_tank_peak, modules.ato) is exceeded by both old-nominal (hard-switched) scenarios tested (694.71V at L=150uH, 403.27V at L=80uH) but NOT by the new 47kHz/L=150uH operating point (331.05V, under 400V) -- the new operating point is the only one of the three tested that is consistent with the declared 400V assumption, in addition to holding ZVS.

determinism.method: run_tank_coil_sweep.py invoked 3 times at the identical (L=150uH, ratio=1.249998, cast_iron) new-operating-point override; measured result fields (margin_pct, i_tank_rms_a, i_tank_pk_a, p_pan_w, f_res_loaded_hz) compared for exact equality across runs.

internal_consistency_check.question: main.ato:74 declares f_resonant_nominal=25kHz; does this match the coil inductance assumptions used elsewhere?
internal_consistency_check.finding: Three distinct, mutually-inconsistent coil inductance assumptions exist in this project's evidence -- 135.1uH (algebraically implied by main.ato:74's declared 25kHz at the fixed 300nF C_TANK), 80uH (pan_load.sub's PANLOAD_TRANSFORMER subckt default, silently used by every prior ZVS sweep because modules.ato's inductor_conn specifies none), and 150uH (this evidence chain's best-supported candidate, chosen because it is the only value tested that also clears OCP-01 at ~1800W). None has ever been measured against the real coil/pan. This was already flagged in docs/hardware/TANK_COIL_SPECIFICATION.md (2026-07-26) for the 80uH-vs-135uH pair; this pass adds the third (150uH) candidate and confirms it does not resolve the mismatch -- it makes it a 3-way disagreement instead of 2-way. NOT resolved by this pass (see the accompanying markdown for why changing f_resonant_nominal itself was rejected as a fix).
internal_consistency_check.robust_conclusion: Regardless of which of the three L values is used, the K=0.79 LOADED resonance for ferromagnetic pans exceeds the OLD declared 35kHz f_switching: ~39.7kHz at L=135.1uH (main.ato's own implied value), ~52.2kHz at L=80uH (sim default), ~37.6kHz at L=150uH (evidence candidate). The conclusion that 35kHz must be raised does not depend on resolving the L ambiguity.
